# Control fixtures (synthetic)

Written 2026-10-18 before any real post arrived. Organisers, venues and wording are invented; they test the reader's paths and the hard cases (relative dates, two dates in one post, a repeat, a cancellation, a non-event, a date with no time, a flyer image). Real posts go in `tests/posts/` as they arrive; the score is reported for the two sets separately.

Each case: one `input.*` file, `meta.json` (`received`), `expected.json` (a list of events; only the fields listed are scored).
